headline: Approved Holyoke Public Library genealogy grant; offered Paper City Arts extension to July 31, 2027; Playground Mural change not approved.
summary: Three grant modification requests changed the original projects. Paper City Arts was offered an extension through July 31, 2027, while the Playground Mural request was not approved, though a new application for the Nov. grant cycle was suggested. The treasurer's report was tabled, and final grant cycle meeting dates were set.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August meeting with changes.
Approved an extension of the Paper City Arts grant through July 31, 2027, including completion of all paperwork.
Did not approve the grant modification for the Playground Mural at Holyoke Heritage State Park.
Approved the Holyoke Public Library grant to fund two genealogy programs by Eileen Crosby, as requested, unanimously.
Set the final grant cycle meeting dates as Nov. 2, Nov. 9, Nov. 10, and Nov. 16, unanimously.
Approved setting the grant cycle meeting start time at 6:00 pm, continuing until 9:00 pm, unanimously.

plain_text:
Holyoke Local Cultural Council 
 September 14, 2026 
 Present: Navae, Tim, Gloria, Mardelle, Chris F., Chris D. 
 Absent: Mark, Rachel 
 Meeting convened at 6:47 pm. 
 Minutes from our August meeting were reviewed and approved with changes. 
 Everyone  took  time  to  review  the  new  grant  modiﬁcation  requests.  Three  grant  modiﬁcation 
 requests were received, each one a signiﬁcant change from the originally funded project. 
 ●  The  ﬁrst  from  Paper  City  Arts,  Natasha  Colon  Ortiz.  Following  discussion  and  reading  the 
 original  grant  application,  the  decision  was  to  oﬀer  an  extension  of  the  original  grant 
 through July 31, 2027,  including completion of all paperwork. 
 ●  Following  discussion,  it  was  suggested  that  a  grant  extension  be  granted  for  the 
 Playground  Mural  at  Holyoke  Heritage  State  Park  project  until  the  end  of  July,  including 
 project  completion  and  all  paperwork.  The  grant  modiﬁcation  was  not  approved. 
 However,  it  was  suggested  that  their  new  project  be  submitted  as  a  new  grant 
 application for the Nov. grant cycle. 
 ●  A  motion  to  approve,  as  requested,  the  Holyoke  Public  Library  grant  to  fund  two 
 genealogy programs by Eileen Crosby.  All approved. 
 Treasurer’s report was tabled. 
 Grant  cycle  ﬁnal  meeting  dates  set  as  Nov.  2,  Nov.  9,  Nov.  10,  and  Nov.  16.  All  approved.  Navae 
 proposed setting the starting time as 6:00 pm, continuing until 9:00 pm.  All approved. 
 New business: Mardelle provided an update on Poet Laureate plans from recent meetings. 
 The next regular meeting will be Oct. 5  th  . 
 Respectfully submitted, 
 Tim Damon, Clerk
